model_identity: simple signed/additive endpoint fairness with deletable heavy edges and fixed-heavy EF residuals

entries.reason: 3^k exact charity search plus lower-bound flow algorithm on simple graphs; 1200 finite random checks with no mismatches, not a universal theorem.
Frozen aggregate of 1200 simple-graph cases, exact integer arithmetic, zero mismatches; preserves finite scope only.
Exact brute versus forest dynamic residual EF feasibility, fixed path counterexample and 4200 random tests; no general multigraph theorem.

scope_note: Simple-graph charity and fixed-heavy forest residual models are separate from fair_chores rank and goods-with-copies; finite no-mismatch records do not prove general fairness or efficiency.
